verdict.rationale: Close documents a dedicated Bulk Actions API resource (e.g., GET /api/v1/bulk_action/email/) and positions bulk actions as a way to manage workflows programmatically. Bulk email is also a plan feature, and the Advanced Filtering API can select many items at once. Missing for 10: documentation of bulk action types beyond email (bulk edit, delete, sequence enrollment), evidence that bulk operations are exposed through the MCP server for AI agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
